title: Measure and combine UTF-8 text
summary: Compare bytes with Unicode scalar values, borrow a valid prefix, append text without consuming the suffix and construct formatted output.

binding.clue: Modifier allowing text to be extended in place

append.clue: Method appending a borrowed string slice to text

borrowed.clue: String method exposing suffix as a shared UTF-8 slice

bytes.clue: String method returning the number of bytes in its encoding

characters.clue: Method iterating Unicode scalar values rather than bytes or grapheme clusters

checked.clue: Method returning an optional UTF-8 substring for a byte range

formatting.clue: Macro constructing owned formatted text while borrowing the interpolated string

equal.clue: Macro comparing the decorated text with the expected bracketed result
